## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_火. Core element Earth, energy element Fire. Law: Fire feeds Earth (火生土: ash becomes soil). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Fire is this core's Mind.

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 土赖火生，火多土焦 (生之太过, the Mind door).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Earth core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Fire as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill; the friction pole of Fire as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel, cure set Water (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, wide, missing, spared, thin, excess. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

mechanism.base.value: Fire feeds Earth, the old texts say. What burns comes down as ash, and ash is the first soil. Every field that grows was warmed before it was planted. The flame readies the ground rather than building it, loosening the cold and leaving a fine black dust that holds water and seed. The ground remembers each fire as a richer season, and a long cold year as a thin harvest.

spec.notes: opens on a plain statement of the state in the reader's terms (Fire named, its volume in ordinary words, the reference lead-in "With too little Fire, …" or any plain statement, never "Run thin," or "Run heavy,"), then the elemental image of the state in one clause that stands alone, what it costs, then ONE plain directive that stands alone, the carry line below is cut from the image clause

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: With too little Fire, the ground goes cold under the seed, and the soil feeds on an old harvest. Take in one warm thing a week, a teacher or a book.

spec.construct: THE THREE BEATS (owner 2026-10-14, D14, function first). Beat 1, the first sentence, is this function's fixed sentence, word for word: "Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours." (the function for anyone; the gate blocks any other first sentence). Beat 2, one sentence: what Fire makes of your Mind, Fire as the agent with its plain verb or state (E7), ending on what that does to the function for this reader; no amount of Fire, no pole. Beat 3, one or two sentences opening on "As a catalyst,": what the shortfall does to the function, then the family's two drives as one either-or (the tension sentence, D9, both personas inside it, E8), the cost as the close (D11, the reader its subject). NEVER an amount of the element anywhere in the definition ("more Earth than", "little Water", "Metal to spare", "runs thin": the gate blocks them; the bars will carry the amount); never the old opener "{Element} is your {Function}, and as a …" (the title line above the definition already says it). Three or four sentences, 30 to 50 words.
spec.chemistry: the field carries one word of the pair's chemistry anywhere in it as the energy's plain verb or state, or the energy's name in the mechanism sentence ("There is more Fire in you than you use"): Fire's or Earth's (flows, pours, settles; grows, builds, reaches; warm, light, fuel; holds, shelters, steady; hard, exact, finishes); never a prop (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, branch, root, stream, flame, heat, burn are blocked and do not count); the element's name in the opener does not count; the gate blocks without it (owner 2026-09-30, narrowed 2026-10-14)
spec.opener: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours.
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (the gate blocks a definition without it)
spec.notes: the family's two drives in one either-or, one clause per persona with its cost, anchored in that persona's ruled domain words, in two or three sentences (no inventory, owner 2026-10-14, polish rule 4); the mechanism sentence is required in a definition and names Fire and its volume in ordinary words. The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

function.definition_friction.value: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. What moves you stays, because Fire keeps it warm. As a friction, you keep taking in after you have enough, sheltering an idea or a person rather than testing either. You know far more than you ever tried.

spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: You learn by being warmed, and warmth is something you have to go and sit near. Once a month sit in on a class or a talk as a listener only. Keep one person you can ask the simple question, and ask it. Read one slow chapter before sleep each night.

spec.remedy_shape: THE REMEDY (owner 2026-10-14): the friction advice renders under its own title, THE REMEDY, after the ledger, and OPENS on the energy prescription beat: "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The beat is the first sentence of the field (the gate blocks any other opening); the one plain truth sentence and the two small life actions follow it, in the cure's register; the field closes on the last action, never on a second beat.
spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), two, in the cure's register (owner 2026-10-14, Q35: on an Order cure someone above you, a deadline, a judge, never a friend; on a Mind cure study, shelter, time; on an Action cure a thing made or shipped; on a Body cure sleep, food, rest; on an Expression cure a thing said or given), the smallest action last, closing on the energy prescription in the energy-manual register (owner 2026-09-29, the beat re-cut 2026-09-30): "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: Seek Water, the Action energy. Water runs down, cools what it touches and carries it away. Let it spend what Fire burns. You have taken in more than you will ever use, and each new idea costs you the last. Decide one open question by a date. Finish one small thing a week and give it away.

spec.pole_neutral: one verdict per pair, rendered on this page whichever pole the chart shows (this batch writes both poles), so it must read true on both: what Fire as your Mind IS, never its state, no heavy, thin, too much, too little, running over, running short
spec.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page (noted on a verdict, the read decides)
spec.notes: explains "Fire is your Mind": a behavioural truth with the reader as its subject plus ONE tendency-framed consequence beat, true on either pole, the tension inside the one sentence where it can be; at least eight words, no arena word, no turn word (but, yet, however), no more than two commas (owner 2026-10-14, v0.7.1)

cta_verdict.value: Your mind takes in what warms it first, so you learn more from one person who lights you up than from any lesson you sat through cold.
cta_verdict.value_b: You take ideas in through the people who carry them, so a warm teacher stays with you longer than a right one.
